'''Liadden''' was a young [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and the [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Seventy-Seven Stars]]''. She was mentored by [[To'iir]], the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], who considered her to be his apprentice in the smuggling trade.

{{Char-stub}}

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[To'iir]] and Liadden were both invited to the private chambers of [[Rithgar]], at the [[Kothlis shadowport]]. While there, To'iir was introduced to [[Tru'eb Cholakk]], and the two traded rumors and information about fellow [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The meeting was broken up early when, unexpectedly, a [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|''Super''-class Star Destroyer]] approached the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].
